about.title: Women's health care that listens first
body: Neo Women's Clinic was started with a simple goal — to give the women of Mugalivakkam and Porur a nearby clinic where gynecological and prenatal care feels personal, not rushed.

Whether you're coming in for a routine wellness checkup, navigating a pregnancy, or working through a concern like PCOS, our team takes the time to explain, listen, and support you through every visit.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can call or WhatsApp us at +91 98944 40207, or use the Book an Appointment button on this site to request a slot.

faqs.question: How often should I visit during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Typically once a month through the first two trimesters, then more frequently in the final trimester. Your doctor will set a personalized schedule at your first visit.

faqs.question: What should I expect at my first visit?
faqs.answer: Your first visit includes a detailed health history discussion, a physical examination if needed, and time set aside for any questions — expect it to run longer than a routine follow-up.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, UPI, and major debit/credit cards at the clinic.

faqs.question: Will my visit be kept private and confidential?
faqs.answer: Yes. All consultations take place in a private room, and your health information is kept strictly confidential.

blogPosts.title: Why Regular Gynecological Checkups Matter, Even When You Feel Fine
blogPosts.excerpt: Routine checkups aren't just for when something feels wrong — here's why an annual visit matters at every age.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Lakshmi Venkatesan
content: Many women only think to see a gynecologist when something feels wrong, but regular checkups are one of the most effective ways to catch concerns early — often before symptoms appear.
A routine visit can screen for infections, hormonal imbalances, and other conditions like PCOS well before they become disruptive, making treatment simpler and more effective.
Checkups are also a chance to discuss anything on your mind, from menstrual changes to family planning, in a private and unhurried setting.

We recommend an annual well-woman visit for most patients, with more frequent visits during pregnancy or when managing an ongoing condition. If it's been over a year since your last visit, it's a good time to book one.
